text: The same five jobs, two designs: v1's pipeline as the Caruca paper describes it, and what the agent chose in run 4
purple = done by a language model · blue = done by hand-written code · red text = where the two designs differ most. Section numbers refer to the Caruca paper (arXiv:2510.14279).

v1, as the

a fixed pipeline:
one model step,
then code

GPT-4o reads the man page or
--help, with 3 worked examples
(rm, mv, touch); the result is
loaded as Python and checked;
up to 3 tries with the error
fed back  (section 3)
2 Choose what to run: code

every combination of up to 4
flags; typed values: integers
-1, 0, 1, every choice, paths
from a file-system model;
inputs: book text, arithmetic,
JSON, images  (section 4)
3 Run and observe: code

each case in a throwaway

fresh namespace, chroot;
strace records every file

diffed after  (section 5)

stateless if running on split
input and joining the outputs
equals one run; inputs and

cwd use  (section 6.3)

adapters translate one

run 4:
the agent

no pipeline:
one model does
every job
1 Syntax: the model

starts from the grep sample,
adds the manual's option lines
and --help (calls 2-6); writes
2 syntaxes. No retry loop:
checked once, later, by its
own test
2 Choose what to run: model

72 cases by hand (calls 5-6),
aimed at edges: -m -1, -A -1,
-m 1k, bad choices, stdin vs
files, -r with no file, -z.
Input: one 4-line text file
and a 2-file directory
3 Run and observe: model

plain shell, files in /tmp;
no sandbox, no namespace, no
strace (installed, unused).
Reads exit codes and printed
output only
4 Decide behaviour: model

reasons from what grep is
documented to do and from the
probes; splits -l from -L;
refuses -q, -m, context, -z.
Its test then checks the classes
against its own expectations
5 Write PaSh's form: model

writes the parser table and
the two Python classes
directly, in one shell call
(call 7); no other
consumers

Scale for grep. v1 generates 122 invocations when held to one flag at a time, out of 1,426,920 with no limit (our E0 study, v1 run in the Lima VM); the paper's default allows up to 4 flags,
and each invocation is paired with several file-system states and input contents. The agent ran grep 72 times before writing and 155 times after, all on files it made by hand.
v1 is shown as the paper designs it (sections 3-6), not as run for this comparison. This compares method, not output quality: neither output has been scored against the ground truth yet.
